help.zonestatus: State of one zone: type, files, serial, dynamic, next refresh.
help.showzone: The zone statement as named runs it, including zones added at run time.
help.fetchlimit: Servers and domains currently rate limited by fetches-per-server and fetches-per-zone.
help.tcp-timeouts: Current TCP timeouts: initial, idle, keepalive and advertised.
help.validation-status: Whether DNSSEC validation is on, per view.
help.signing-list: Signing operations named still has to run for the zone's keys.
help.dnssec-status: DNSSEC policy state of the zone: keys, their roles and next rollovers.
help.serve-stale-status: Whether stale answers are served, per view.
help.managed-keys-status: State of the RFC 5011 trust anchors, per view.
help.nta-dump: List the negative trust anchors and their expiry.
help.reload: Reload the configuration and zones, or only the zone given.
help.reconfig: Reload the configuration and load new zones only, without reloading unchanged ones.
help.notify: Send NOTIFY for the zone to its secondaries now.
help.retransfer: Transfer the secondary zone again from its primary, even when the serial did not change.
help.freeze: Suspend dynamic updates and write the journal into the zone file, to edit it by hand.
help.thaw: Reload a frozen zone and accept dynamic updates again.
help.refresh: Check the primary's serial of a secondary zone now and transfer when it is newer.
help.loadkeys: Load the zone's keys from the key directory and sign with them.
help.sign: Load the zone's keys and fully re-sign the zone.
help.trace: Raise the debug level by one, or set it to the level given.
help.notrace: Set the debug level back to 0.
help.sync: Write the journal of dynamic zones into their files.
help.flush: Empty the resolver cache (of one view when given).
help.flushname: Remove one name from the cache.
help.flushtree: Remove a name and everything below it from the cache.
help.querylog: Turn query logging on or off.
help.nta-add: Add a negative trust anchor: validation is skipped for the name until it expires.
help.nta-remove: Remove a negative trust anchor: the name is validated again.
help.serve-stale: Turn serving stale answers on or off, or reset it to the configured value.
help.managed-keys-refresh: Check the trust anchors for new keys now (RFC 5011).
help.stats: Append the statistics counters to the statistics file.
help.dumpdb: Write the cache content to the dump file.
help.status-get: Daemon status: pid, uptime, reload time, HA state and multithreading.
help.build-report: How this Kea was built: version, options and libraries.
help.list-commands: Every command the daemon accepts with the hooks it loaded.
help.statistic-get-all: Every statistic counter of the server.
help.statistic-reset: Reset one statistic counter to zero.
help.statistic-reset-all: Reset every statistic counter of the server.
help.config-reload: Load the configuration file again, dropping changes not written to it.
help.ha-heartbeat: Ask the HA hook for this server's state and its view of the clock.
help.ha-sync: Fetch every lease from the partner (server-name) into this server.
help.ha-scopes: Set the HA scopes this server answers for, for example during maintenance.
help.ha-continue: Resume the HA state machine after a pause.
help.ha-reset: Put the HA state machine back to waiting: the servers synchronize again.
help.dhcp-disable: Stop answering clients (for max-period seconds when given).
help.leases-reclaim: Reclaim expired leases now; remove deletes them instead of keeping them expired.
help.config-backend-pull: Fetch the configuration changes from the configuration backend now.
help.cache-flush: Remove the given number of entries from the host cache, or all of them.
help.lease4-resend-ddns: Send the DNS update of an IPv4 lease to kea-dhcp-ddns again.
help.lease4-wipe: Delete every IPv4 lease, of one subnet when given.
help.lease6-resend-ddns: Send the DNS update of an IPv6 lease to kea-dhcp-ddns again.
help.lease6-wipe: Delete every IPv6 lease, of one subnet when given.
